# Vendored third-party code

- **safetyhook** (`safetyhook/`, `safetyhook/src/`) — cursey/safetyhook,
  MIT License. Amalgamated copy taken from the New Classics PC reference
  (`ref/nc/include/safetyhook`). Includes bundled Zydis (MIT License).
- **toml++** (`tomlplusplus/toml.hpp`) — marzer/tomlplusplus v3.1.0,
  MIT License (header carries SPDX notice).
- **Dear ImGui** (`imgui/`) — ocornut/imgui v1.88 release, MIT License
  (`imgui/LICENSE.txt`). Core files + `backends/imgui_impl_dx11.*` and
  `backends/imgui_impl_win32.*`.
- **New Classics** code excerpts (in `src/game/hooks.h`, `src/game/diva.h`,
  `src/game/diva.cpp`, `src/game/MpSelPc.cpp`) — MIT License; source:
  https://github.com/mrcloverthecoder/nc (New Classics PC). License preserved at
  `third_party/LICENSE.newclassics.txt`.
